claim: getRelationKeysByModel never assigns the computed value back to relationKeysByModel, so it is never memoized and buildRelationKeysByModel(db._?.schema) is recomputed on every joined query instead of once.

The lazy relation-keys getter reads db._?.schema instead of db._?.relations (what the removed line and the module's own v2 tests expect), so relation keys are built from the wrong/absent metadata and joins break for the relations-v2 adapter.

The lazy relation-key getter for the Relations v2 adapter now reads db._?.schema instead of db._?.relations, the field the removed pre-PR line used and the field this adapter's own metadata actually lives on (confirmed by the test's `relationMetadata: { relations: {} }` mock for the v2 adapter factory), so it builds the relation-key map from the wrong, typically undefined source and joins silently lose their relation keys.

getRelationKeysByModel uses `??` instead of `??=`, so relationKeysByModel is never assigned and buildRelationKeysByModel(db._?.schema) is recomputed on every call instead of being cached once as the lazy-init refactor intends, unlike the sibling relations-v2 getter which correctly uses `??=`.
